in_hebrew.name: Hadara
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hadara הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Hadara is derived from the Hebrew word הדרה (Hadarah), which means ‘myrtle tree’. Myrtle is a small, evergreen tree with white, fragrant flowers and is mentioned in the Old Testament several times. In the Bible, myrtle trees are associated with beauty, grace, and joy. Hadara is also the name of a concubine in King Solomon's harem, mentioned in the books of 1 Kings and 2 Chronicles.
